⚠️ Important Warning Before Starting (Lockout Risk & Self-Responsibility)

Hinata requires Android Accessibility to remain ON at all times to control edge navigation. If system navigation (such as 3-button controls) is hidden and Hinata is stopped or Accessibility is turned off due to OS battery savers, memory cleanup, or bugs, you may lose Back/Home controls and face a navigation lockout. Although Hinata includes automatic recovery and Quick Panel escape tools, the developer assumes zero liability for any stoppage, lockout, or device issue — you use this app strictly at your own risk.

Sends extracted text only for natural, high-accuracy paragraph translation. Automatically falls back to offline translation when unreachable.

• Only text extracted from the screen is sent to the translation server — screenshots and images are never transmitted.
• Password fields and protected screens (FLAG_SECURE) are automatically excluded.
• You can switch back to Offline (Local) anytime to stop all network requests completely.
• When offline or rate-limited, Hinata automatically falls back to on-device offline translation.
